name: Chicago Life 😈
desc:
👍 Like the game for more updates! 

Welcome To Chicago Life! 💯
Explore the streets of Chicago in an open world where you decide what happens. Build powerful factions, take over territory, and use strategy and skill to dominate your rivals.

🎮 Console Supported
💰 Heists
🔫 Weapons
🚗 Cars
📦 Safe Storage 
🏠 Homes


CONTROLS:
R2 TO SHOOT
L2 TO SPRINT

📢 Important:
Shutdowns indicate updates to improve your gaming experience.
